signal: Filevine raised $400M across two rounds led by Accel, Insight Partners and Halo Fund to scale its AI-powered legal platform

email.body1:
Brian, saw Filevine raised $400M across two rounds led by Accel and Insight to scale the AI legal platform.

Capital and an AI roadmap like that usually mean more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brian, quick follow-up for Filevine.

After a raise that size, board expectations on enterprise pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your enterprise team needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brian, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's enterprise reply rate likely compares to other well-funded legal-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brian, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while you deploy the new capital, no problem at all. The stretch right after a raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise legal-tech motion? I'll tailor it to Filevine either way.
